blocks.text: President Donald Trump made myriad false and misleading claims during his address to the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday, many of which he has repeated frequently throughout his second term in the White House. They covered topics such as U.S. munitions supply, drug seizures, oil and the economy. Here’s a closer look at the facts. CLAIM: “We have more munitions than we could ever possibly even think of using, and we’re building them at levels that we have never done before.” THE FACTS: Published reports and experts contradict this claim.
